# @dxtmisha/storybook

> Storybook development, interactive component playground, and documentation build package for DXT UI.

Hosts the Storybook instance configured with `@storybook/vue3-vite`, MDX documentation plugins, accessibility checks, and dynamic design token integration.

## Key Configuration & Files

- [.storybook/main.ts](.storybook/main.ts): Storybook core configuration, Vite builder settings, and MDX addons.
- [.storybook/preview.ts](.storybook/preview.ts): Global preview decorators, theme providers, and control definitions.
- [package.json](package.json): Storybook scripts (`npm run storybook`, `npm run build-storybook`).

## Optional

- [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts): Local Vite configuration for Storybook.
